command_ordering: Every ordinary accepted LLD-02 command follows LLD-01 ordering: idempotency check -> pure bounded preflight -> open UnitOfWork -> load/revalidate authoritative state -> detect semantic NO_CHANGE when applicable -> allocate immutable IDs -> insert command_receipt -> domain/lifecycle writes -> audit -> commit. Any later failure rolls the receipt back with the command.
preflight_rule: Pure normalization, field-bound checks and syntax validation occur before BEGIN IMMEDIATE where possible. State-dependent uniqueness/eligibility/review freshness is always revalidated inside the authoritative UnitOfWork. No external I/O, DNS, operator wait or unbounded computation occurs while the write transaction is held.

commands.name: CreateCustomerOrganization
commands.transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 authoritative UnitOfWork after pure preflight
steps: validate bounds and compute governed match keys
inside UnitOfWork detect any active different Account Code claimant and return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW with no mutation
allocate customer_org_id/optional identifier_id/lifecycle_event_id
insert command_receipt
insert active Customer revision 1
insert optional active Account Code claim
append created lifecycle event
insert audit/result references
commit
rules: equal name never blocks explicit creation solely as identity duplication
Customer Account Code is external matching evidence, never relational ID
reviewed duplicate-code preservation uses ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim after Customer creation

commands.name: SetCustomerAccountCode
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Customer/revalidate revision
query complete active claimant state for normalized code
if target already owns exactly the requested accepted claim apply SemanticNoChange
if any other Customer claims the code and target does not already hold it return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW
otherwise insert receipt, supersede target's different prior active code if any, insert new active claim, increment Customer revision, audit, commit
rules: source/import evidence never calls this without its owning reviewed acceptance

commands.name: ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed acceptance that one normalized Customer Account Code may currently have more than one canonical Customer Organization claimant
steps: inside UnitOfWork validate exact review_snapshot_hash against current claimant/target state
require at least one different active claimant
load/revalidate target Customer
if target already owns exact claim apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise allocate identifier ID, insert receipt, supersede target's different active code if present, insert active shared claim, increment target revision, audit exact reviewed correction, commit
rules: future matching remains AMBIGUOUS while multiple active claimants survive

commands.name: ReassignCustomerAccountCode
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed correction moving one active Account Code claim from one Customer Organization to another
steps: inside UnitOfWork validate exact review_snapshot_hash against current claimant/source/target state
require distinct active Customers and revalidate both revisions
prove source has active claim for reviewed code
insert receipt
supersede source claim
supersede target's different active code if one was part of reviewed snapshot
insert reviewed code claim for target
increment affected Customer revisions
audit all changed identifiers/Customers and review binding
commit
rules: does not rewrite historical Customer context
does not silently alter any third Customer sharing the code
failure anywhere rolls back every claim/revision/audit change

commands.name: CreateContact
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure name/channel validation
steps: validate/normalize name and optional email via ContactChannelPolicy
inside UnitOfWork validate referenced active Customer if supplied
allocate Contact/optional channel/affiliation/lifecycle IDs
insert receipt
insert Contact
insert optional active channel
insert optional current affiliation
append created lifecycle event
audit
commit
rules: zero affiliation and zero channels are valid
equal name/email evidence never silently selects an existing Contact

commands.name: UpdateContactDescriptiveData
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure name validation
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact/revalidate revision
if stored accepted name+derived key already equal request apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, update name/key/revision, append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event, audit bounded prior/new evidence, commit
rules: does not alter contact_id, affiliation or channels

commands.name: AddContactChannel
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact/revalidate revision
allocate channel ID
insert receipt
insert active channel revision 1
increment Contact revision
audit
commit

commands.name: UpdateContactChannel
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after channel validation preflight
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and owned active channel/revalidate both revisions
if stored accepted value+key equal request apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, update value/key/channel revision, increment Contact revision, audit bounded prior/new evidence, commit
rules: channel_kind immutable for channel identity; changing kind requires archive + add

commands.name: ArchiveContactChannel
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and owned active channel/revalidate both revisions
insert receipt
archive channel/increment channel revision
increment Contact revision
audit
commit
rules: archived channel no longer matches or qualifies for recipient selection

commands.name: ChangeContactAffiliation
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact/current affiliation/revalidate revision
validate new Customer active when non-null
if requested affiliation equals current exact target including null apply SemanticNoChange

otherwise allocate new affiliation ID when needed, insert receipt, close current affiliation with closing provenance, insert new current affiliation when non-null, increment Contact revision, audit relationship change, commit
rules: historical affiliations never rewritten to current

commands.name: CreateStandaloneDispatchLocation
steps: validate bounded name/address and compute key
inside UnitOfWork allocate location/lifecycle IDs, insert receipt, insert active standalone location, append created lifecycle event, audit, commit
rules: operation role not stored on master

commands.name: CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite
commands.visibility: internal cross-domain service used by LLD-08 coordinator
steps: verify precomputed key belongs to exact supplied name and active matching profile
allocate location/lifecycle IDs
insert site_derived location with null standalone address
append created lifecycle event referencing shared receipt
return identity/event to LLD-08 coordinator for Site relation + final audit before shared commit
commands.rule: failure of Site/relation/audit rolls back Dispatch Location/lifecycle/receipt in same UnitOfWork

commands.name: UpdateReferenceDescriptiveData
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active target/revalidate revision
if all governed stored fields/derived keys equal request apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, update allowed fields/increment revision, append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event, audit bounded prior/new evidence, commit
rules: site_derived address cannot be overwritten here

commands.name: WriteSetting
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after strict JSON + state-independent preflight
steps: outside write transaction resolve closed SettingDefinition and strict JSON/state-independent validation
inside UnitOfWork revalidate persisted revision/absence and run bounded state-dependent owner checks
if same contract/version and SettingDefinition.semantic_equals(current,requested) apply SemanticNoChange
otherwise insert receipt, INSERT or explicit UPDATE setting with next revision, audit, commit
rules: secret-classified settings rejected from this store

commands.name: CreateLocalUserProfileIdentity
input: existing UnitOfWork from LLD-12 setup coordinator
steps: require shared setup idempotency/order
require no singleton row
validate bounded username
insert singleton metadata identity
return without internal commit
commands.rule: LLD-12 owns verifier/auto-login and commits metadata+authentication state atomically or rolls all back
